name: hud_ui_composite_panel_constructor_with_entry_count
description: HudUiCompositePanel entry-count construction builds the panel base, initializes the entry vector, installs the composite ftable, builds default transition-text entries, applies the reference glyph text, clears and hides entries through the resize/reapply path, lays out at the origin, and marks the panel visible.
known_limits: Depends on the composite-panel vector/entry helpers and HudUiPanel formatting/layout helpers, which are functionally accepted but remain tier S debt.

Binary Ninja still represents the original MSVC constructor EH state, empty allocator byte storage, and member construction source shape as low-level artifacts; byte-safe shape should be revisited with the full composite-panel class/source-file pass.

The source exposes the entry-count form directly as HudUiCompositePanel::HudUiCompositePanel(int), matching BN caller 0x403930's member construction need; the former no-retail compatibility wrapper was removed from production source.

VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob1 /GX /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ??0HudUiCompositePanel@@QAE@H@Z at 0x4bb790 still fails after recovering the constructor symbol shape: 339 unmasked mismatches, 60 relocation bytes masked, 13 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, Binary Ninja body is 461 bytes and the VC object symbol is 400 bytes.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja shows HudUiPanel::ConstructorDefault, vector begin/end/capacity zeroing, composite ftable install, template transition-text entry construction/destruction, entry vector resize to entryCount, SetTextFmt with the shared reference glyph "W" at 0x4e0be4, layout, resize/reapply, virtual SetVisible(true), and return of self.

The native constructor smoke validates return identity, composite ftable installation, entry-vector count/capacity, transition-text entry ftable installation, cleared/hidden entries, origin layout, and final visible panel state.
